source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Building polygons

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter listed building, bound in the same official feature to ListEntry/Name/Grade evidence. Historic England's live NHLE Listed Building polygons layer is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer and exposes ListEntry, Name and Grade fields under OGL, but the selected source window is layer-level schema/coverage metadata only and exposes no record-level Exeter feature geometry coordinates; therefore source-area metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
